name: NYC Second Chance Rescue
neighborhoods: NYC-based; pulls from NYC ACC + overcrowded shelters
notes:
501(c)(3) since 2009. SPECIALTY: critically injured/neglected/abused dogs & cats pulled from ACC 'death row' - many need emergency vet care. Foster + private-boarding based, no shelter. Queens-based but rescues citywide. Contact via site. Intake: Contact form + adoption app at Other channel: PO Box 570701, Whitestone NY 11357

501(c)(3) since 2009; 17,000+ animals saved. NYC-based, foster-based, known for taking CRITICALLY injured, neglected, and abused dogs & cats (many bully + mixed breeds) from overcrowded shelters and funding medical care and rehabilitation. No walk-in shelter. Also publishes lost/found guidance. Mailing New York, NY. Phone: (no public phone; contact via site) Intake: Lost-pet tips at /lost-pet
